gpu_readout_components.scope: GPU-synchronized readout components for cases with reviewer records; replay excludes model loading, display includes reference transport/native unembedding/top20 and candidate ranking; components are from offline processing

scope: Recorded automated-review request elapsed time, including request retries/backoff where present. Max of two per-call durations is an idealized parallel-review component, not measured total decision latency.
excluded_from_latency: Model trajectory generation and activation extraction
limitations: Concurrent call durations must not be summed and called elapsed wall time
No currency cost inferred without pinned billing rates; token usage is not an invoice
Offline benchmark, not demonstrated real-time monitoring
